**Why Choose AMA as your Manufacturing ****Partner?**

# #### What sets us apart and why you should choose us as your Manufacturing Partner.

**Experienced Team******

Our team at AMA SPORT is composed of seasoned professionals with expertise in product development,
design, and manufacturing. We are committed to offering you comprehensive solutions that ensure the
success of your projects, from concept to completion.





******Strategic Locations**
AMA SPORT's factories are strategically located in key manufacturing regions across China, including
Zhejiang, Guangdong, Hunan, Hubei,and Gansu. These locations not only enhance production efficiency
but also enable significant cost savings, which we pass on to you, our valued customers.
******Vast Manufacturing Network**

Since 2016, AMA SPORT has established an extensive manufacturing network across China, operating
seven factories that specialize in products such as Tennis,Padel,Beach Tennis,Pickleball,Sport
Bags,Sport Grips, and other carbon composite materials. Our product lines range from entry-level to
high-end markets, providing comprehensive solutions to meet your needs.



******Trustworthy Partnership**
At AMA SPORT, trust and transparency are the core values that drive our business. We prioritize our
customers' interests, aiming to build long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships based on
reliability and integrity.
**Our core manufacturing capabilities include******

With extensive experience in manufacturing since 2016, supported by a team of over 130 seasoned
engineers and the successful completion of around 17,869 projects, we at AMA SPORT consider
ourselves experts in a wide range of carbon fiber and composite material processes, particularly in
the field of high-performance rackets.
* 
* ●  Prepreg Layup and Autoclave Curing
  ●  Resin Transfer Molding (RTM)
  ●  Compression Molding
  ●  CNC Machining for Precision Components
  ●  Braiding and Taping for Structural Integrity
  ●  Surface Treatment and Finishing
  ●  Custom Tooling and Mold Fabrication
  ●  Automated Quality Inspection Systems
  ● Finishing Customization Product
  ● Constant R&D and Invonation

**Who we work with?**
Our experienced team and adaptable approach allow us to collaborate effectively with a diverse range
of global clients in the carbon fiber racket industry. AMA SPORT's clients span from large-scale
multinationals and SMEs to start-ups, and even individual innovators taking their first steps into
the specialized world of high-performance sports equipment manufacturing.
We have successfully assisted numerous global companies in developing and increasing their sales
with us by our skillful manufacturering process and high quality requirements to their products.
With a growing team of engineers skilled in various technical disciplines, we are confident that no
racket sport product is beyond our capabilities.
Get In Touch with AMA
******About Us**

ZHEJIANG AMA SPORT GOODS CO.,. ("AMA GROUP") was founded in 2019 as a comprehensive technology and
innovation company focused on professional manufacturing, research and development, and
international brand building. 



We operate the industry's first standardized racket factory and Six modern and satellite factories,
enabling us to meet high-end production demands,Establishing 

the industry's first "Rural Revitalization Factory" in Gansu.



Our mission is "Make It Happen," and our vision is "Help 100 brands to be the leadership in their
specific territory." We uphold the core values of "Unity, 

Dedication, Learning, Innovation, Integrity, Pragmatism, Fairness, and Mutual Benefit."

******------ ****AMA - Do What You Love!**

## FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions
1. How many factories does AMA SPORT have?

AMA SPORT currently operates seven directly-owned factories located in Guangdong, Hubei, Hunan,
Gansu, and Zhejiang provinces in China. These factories are fully equipped to meet comprehensive
customization needs and are among the leading manufacturers in the industry.



2. What products does AMA SPORT primarily produce?


AMA SPORT primarily produces composite tennis rackets, beach tennis rackets, pickleball paddles, and
related accessories such as paddle covers, protective tape, and grips. Our products are widely used
in various racket sports, and we are committed to providing high-quality sports equipment.



3. What are the core features of AMA SPORT’s production?

Our production process utilizes advanced equipment, extensive production experience, and a 70%
automation rate, combined with a unique standardized production management system. This ensures
stable production supply, high-quality products, and reliable delivery times to meet customer needs.
Our brand philosophy, "Today's Quality, Tomorrow's Market," ensures that every product undergoes
rigorous quality testing for the best user experience.



4. How do I choose the right factory for my needs?

AMA SPORT recommends the most suitable factory based on the specific needs of different customers,
including their stage of development, production requirements, product distribution region, and
budget constraints. We can match entrepreneurs to established brands with the best manufacturers. We
suggest reviewing the descriptions, introductions, overviews, and customer reviews of each of our
factories or contacting our customer service for professional advice.



5. Does AMA SPORT offer customization services?


Yes, AMA SPORT offers customization services. We can adjust the material, design, and performance
parameters of the rackets according to customer requirements to create personalized sports
equipment.



6. How can I stay updated on the latest products and promotions?

You can stay updated by visiting our official website or subscribing to our email newsletter for the
latest product releases and promotions.

**Our Product Consulting Custom Process******

# We can help you improve every step of your manufacturing process.

AMA SPORT is committed to delivering a seamless and highly efficient customization process for our
B2B clients, ensuring that you receive top-quality products that meet the specific needs of your
organization and customers.
[detailed requirements]

### 1. Send us your detailed requirements

We start by gathering your detailed requirements during a comprehensive consultation. This includes
discussing materials, molds,constructions, and any specific preferences or goals you have. The more
information you can provide, the easier will be for our team to evaluate your project.

### 2. Design and Evaluation

Based on your requirements, our engineering team conducts a Manufacturing evaluation. We offer free
design services from our professional designers, or you can provide your own designs. After
finalizing all details, we create a proof for your approval and make any necessary adjustments until
you're completely satisfied.

### 3. Prototyping

We’ll produce a prototype of your custom product. This prototype allows you to evaluate the quality,
appearance, and performance of the product before moving forward with full production. You can test
the sample and provide any feedback or request additional modifications. We aim to meet your exact
specifications and requirements at this stage.

### 4. Mass Production

Our mass production process utilizes the most advanced manufacturering line, ensure efficiency and
quality at every stage. We collaborate closely with multiple accessory and material suppliers to
ensures efficient and high-quality production. For larger orders, we welcome you to visit our
factory to observe the production progress firsthand, ensuring transparency and confidence in the
timely delivery of your product.

### 5. Quality Control 

### and Inspection

Our quality control team conducts thorough inspections during and after production to guarantee that
all products meet our high standards and your expectations. Any products failing to pass our quality
checks will be removed from the batch. We also offer comprehensive Quality Control Inspections to
identify potential flaws and maintain consistent output.

### 6. Shipping and Delivery

Once the production pass quality control, they are securely packaged and shipped to your specified
location. We work with reliable shipping partners to ensure timely and safe delivery of your order.
You will be provided with a tracking number as soon as it becomes available, and we can assist with
international freight and 3PL services if needed.
Please read our FAQ below for more info, associated fees, products we can manufacture, minimum order
quantities, and to see if your project will be suitable for us.

**Why Choose AMA as your Manufacturing ****Partner?**

# #### What sets us apart and why you should choose us as your Manufacturing Partner.

**Experienced Team******

Our team at AMA SPORT is composed of seasoned professionals with expertise in product development,
design, and manufacturing. We are committed to offering you comprehensive solutions that ensure the
success of your projects, from concept to completion.





******Strategic Locations**
AMA SPORT's factories are strategically located in key manufacturing regions across China, including
Zhejiang, Guangdong, Hunan, Hubei,and Gansu. These locations not only enhance production efficiency
but also enable significant cost savings, which we pass on to you, our valued customers.
******Vast Manufacturing Network**

Since 2016, AMA SPORT has established an extensive manufacturing network across China, operating
seven factories that specialize in products such as Tennis,Padel,Beach Tennis,Pickleball,Sport
Bags,Sport Grips, and other carbon composite materials. Our product lines range from entry-level to
high-end markets, providing comprehensive solutions to meet your needs.



******Trustworthy Partnership**
At AMA SPORT, trust and transparency are the core values that drive our business. We prioritize our
customers' interests, aiming to build long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships based on
reliability and integrity.
**Our core manufacturing capabilities include******

With extensive experience in manufacturing since 2016, supported by a team of over 130 seasoned
engineers and the successful completion of around 17,869 projects, we at AMA SPORT consider
ourselves experts in a wide range of carbon fiber and composite material processes, particularly in
the field of high-performance rackets.
* 
* ●  Prepreg Layup and Autoclave Curing
  ●  Resin Transfer Molding (RTM)
  ●  Compression Molding
  ●  CNC Machining for Precision Components
  ●  Braiding and Taping for Structural Integrity
  ●  Surface Treatment and Finishing
  ●  Custom Tooling and Mold Fabrication
  ●  Automated Quality Inspection Systems
  ● Finishing Customization Product
  ● Constant R&D and Invonation

multinationals and SMEs to start-ups, and even individual innovators taking their first steps into

We have successfully assisted numerous global companies in developing and increasing their sales
with us by our skillful manufacturering process and high quality requirements to their products.
With a growing team of engineers skilled in various technical disciplines, we are confident that no
racket sport product is beyond our capabilities.
Get In Touch with AMA
******About Us**

ZHEJIANG AMA SPORT GOODS CO.,. ("AMA GROUP") was founded in 2019 as a comprehensive technology and
innovation company focused on professional manufacturing, research and development, and
international brand building. 



We operate the industry's first standardized racket factory and Six modern and satellite factories,
enabling us to meet high-end production demands,Establishing 

the industry's first "Rural Revitalization Factory" in Gansu.



Our mission is "Make It Happen," and our vision is "Help 100 brands to be the leadership in their
specific territory." We uphold the core values of "Unity, 

Dedication, Learning, Innovation, Integrity, Pragmatism, Fairness, and Mutual Benefit."

******------ ****AMA - Do What You Love!**

## FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions
1. How many factories does AMA SPORT have?

AMA SPORT currently operates seven directly-owned factories located in Guangdong, Hubei, Hunan,
Gansu, and Zhejiang provinces in China. These factories are fully equipped to meet comprehensive
customization needs and are among the leading manufacturers in the industry.



2. What products does AMA SPORT primarily produce?


AMA SPORT primarily produces composite tennis rackets, beach tennis rackets, pickleball paddles, and
related accessories such as paddle covers, protective tape, and grips. Our products are widely used
in various racket sports, and we are committed to providing high-quality sports equipment.



3. What are the core features of AMA SPORT’s production?

Our production process utilizes advanced equipment, extensive production experience, and a 70%
automation rate, combined with a unique standardized production management system. This ensures
stable production supply, high-quality products, and reliable delivery times to meet customer needs.
Our brand philosophy, "Today's Quality, Tomorrow's Market," ensures that every product undergoes
rigorous quality testing for the best user experience.



4. How do I choose the right factory for my needs?

AMA SPORT recommends the most suitable factory based on the specific needs of different customers,
including their stage of development, production requirements, product distribution region, and
budget constraints. We can match entrepreneurs to established brands with the best manufacturers. We
suggest reviewing the descriptions, introductions, overviews, and customer reviews of each of our
factories or contacting our customer service for professional advice.



5. Does AMA SPORT offer customization services?


Yes, AMA SPORT offers customization services. We can adjust the material, design, and performance
parameters of the rackets according to customer requirements to create personalized sports
equipment.



6. How can I stay updated on the latest products and promotions?

You can stay updated by visiting our official website or subscribing to our email newsletter for the
latest product releases and promotions.

Call bombing is a form of harassment where an individual’s phone number is flooded with a large
volume of automated calls in a short time. The purpose is to overwhelm the user’s phone to make it
impossible to use for legitimate communication and causing significant disruption.

How do call bombing tools operate?

target phone number, and the service then initiates hundreds or thousands of simultaneous calls to
that number. These tools often mask the caller’s identity to maintain anonymity.

FAQ

## Common questions.

What are your operating hours?

We are open 24/7 for our members. Our concierge team is available from 9 AM to 9 PM, Monday through
Saturday to assist with any requests.

What is included in the membership?

All memberships include high-speed internet, access to common areas, complimentary beverages
(coffee/tea), printing credits, and access to our networking events.

Is there parking available?

Yes, we offer ample parking space for both two-wheelers and four-wheelers at all our locations.
Valet services are available for private office members.

Can I change my plan later?

Absolutely. Our flexible terms allow you to upgrade or downscale your workspace as your team grows.
Just let us know 30 days in advance.

## Common questions.

What are your operating hours?

We are open 24/7 for our members. Our concierge team is available from 9 AM to 9 PM, Monday through
Saturday to assist with any requests.

What is included in the membership?

All memberships include high-speed internet, access to common areas, complimentary beverages
(coffee/tea), printing credits, and access to our networking events.

Is there parking available?

Yes, we offer ample parking space for both two-wheelers and four-wheelers at all our locations.
Valet services are available for private office members.

Can I change my plan later?

Absolutely. Our flexible terms allow you to upgrade or downscale your workspace as your team grows.
Just let us know 30 days in advance.

integration work between products.

# IMPERIUM CORRECTIONAL CONTROL

### Simplify your correctional and jail security

ECC has helped keep correctional facilities safe, secure, and connected for over 30 years. With this
experience, we've created our own intelligent correctional control solution — IMPERIUM®.

Imperium is the first and only Jail Control System [endorsed by the National Sheriffs
Association][95]. It simplifies your security and gives you complete control of your facility right
from a touch screen. From doors to intercom, to camera call-up to lighting and more, Imperium gives
you complete correctional and jail control. Click the button below to get connected to better
correctional security.

As a Partner Alliance for Safer Schools (PASS) Partner and PASS Advisory Council Member, ECC has
always embraced the highest standard of safety preparedness. We've helped keep schools protected for
over 60 years with the understanding that no single security solution can solely address every issue
and a layered systems approach is the most effective solution.

Through our experience, we've developed the IMPERIUM Educational Control System that gives schools a
streamlined Security Management System that integrates all of their core systems together on a
single touch screen. From access control to intercom, to gun and gunshot detection to video
surveillance, Imperium gives you school security control at the touch of a finger.

Méthodologie

## Comment fonctionne un système d'affichage dynamique ?

Fonctionnement : une interface web, un player connecté à internet, vos écrans.

1

### Créer

Depuis une interface web en cloud (plateforme SaaS), l'utilisateur crée ses médias et organise ses
contenus en toute simplicité.

2

### Programmer

Planifiez la diffusion par horaire, déclenchez une alerte ou une annonce ciblée selon vos objectifs.

3

### Diffuser

Via une connexion internet, le player relié à l'écran reçoit les données depuis le serveur et met à
jour vos contenus en temps réel sur tout votre réseau.

### Le saviez-vous ?

La gestion centralisée permet de piloter **plusieurs lieux** et de déployer des mises à jour
simultanément, en quelques clics.

Méthodologie

## Comment fonctionne un système d'affichage dynamique ?

Fonctionnement : une interface web, un player connecté à internet, vos écrans.

1

### Créer

Depuis une interface web en cloud (plateforme SaaS), l'utilisateur crée ses médias et organise ses
contenus en toute simplicité.

2

### Programmer

Planifiez la diffusion par horaire, déclenchez une alerte ou une annonce ciblée selon vos objectifs.

3

### Diffuser

Via une connexion internet, le player relié à l'écran reçoit les données depuis le serveur et met à
jour vos contenus en temps réel sur tout votre réseau.

### Le saviez-vous ?

La gestion centralisée permet de piloter **plusieurs lieux** et de déployer des mises à jour
simultanément, en quelques clics.

centaines de contenus et de gérer des plages de programmation de diffusion.

Quelle que soit votre demande, notre bureau d'études est là pour s'adapter au mieux à celle-ci. Nos

### Écrans connectés

EMITY permet de diffuser simplement une typologie de contenu provenant d'un flux Web, API, base de
données, flux RSS, Météo, Trafic, API Immobilière et bien plus encore.

# Flipper Zero

## Multi-tool Device for Geeks

Flipper Zero is a portable multi-tool for pentesters and geeks in a toy-like body. It loves hacking
digital stuff, such as radio protocols, access control systems, hardware, and more. It's fully
open-source and customizable, so you can extend it in whatever way you like.

[BUY NOW][15]

# What is Flipper Zero

### Your cyber buddy

Flipper Zero is a tiny piece of hardware with a curious personality of a cyber-dolphin. It can
interact with digital systems in real life and grow while you use it. Explore any kind of access
control system, RFID, radio protocols, and debug hardware using GPIO pins.

The idea of Flipper Zero is to combine all the hardware tools you'd need for exploration and
development on the go. Flipper was inspired by the pwnagotchi project, but unlike other DIY boards,
Flipper is designed with the convenience of everyday usage in mind — it has a robust case, handy
buttons, and shape, so there are no dirty PCBs or scratchy pins. Flipper turns your projects into a
game, reminding you that development should always be fun.

[Flipper Zero top view] 1.4" monochrome LCD display
128x64 px, ultra-low power
sunlight-readable 5-button directional pad Back button Status LED

Flipper Zero is completely autonomous and can be controlled with a 5-button directional pad without
additional devices, such as computers or smartphones. Main features are available from the Main
Menu.

For more control, you can connect to Flipper Zero via USB and Bluetooth. Instead of a TFT, IPS or
OLED, we decided to build in a cool old-school LCD.

# Sub-1 GHz Transceiver

### Sub-1 GHz Range

This is the operating range for a wide class of wireless devices and access control systems, such as
garage door remotes, boom barriers, IoT sensors and remote keyless systems. Users can expand their
Flipper Zero capabilities by installing additional apps to read data from various devices including
weather stations.

Flipper has an integrated multi-band antenna, and a CC1101 chip, making it a powerful transceiver
**with a range of up to 50 meters**.

Smart sockets and bulbs
IoT sensors and doorbells
Garage doors and barriers

### Customizable radio platform

CC1101 is a universal transceiver designed for very low-power wireless applications. It supports
various types of digital modulations such as 2-FSK, 4-FSK, GFSK and MSK, as well as OOK and flexible
ASK shaping. You can perform any digital communication in your applications such as connecting to
IoT devices and access control systems.

# 125 kHz RFID

### Low-frequency proximity cards

This type of card is widely used in old access control systems around the world. It's pretty dumb,
stores only an N-byte ID and has no authentication mechanism, allowing it to be read, cloned and
emulated by anyone. A 125 kHz antenna is located on the bottom of Flipper Zero — it can read
low-frequency proximity cards and save them to memory to emulate later.

You can also emulate cards by entering their IDs manually.
Moreover, Flipper Zero owners can share card IDs remotely with other Flipper Zero users.

# NFC

### High-frequency proximity cards

Flipper Zero has a built-in NFC module (13.56 MHz). Along with the 125 kHz RFID module, it turns
Flipper Zero into an ultimate RFID device operating in both low-frequency (LF) and high-frequency
(HF) ranges. The NFC module supports all the major standards.

# Flipper Zero

## Multi-tool Device for Geeks

Flipper Zero is a portable multi-tool for pentesters and geeks in a toy-like body. It loves hacking
digital stuff, such as radio protocols, access control systems, hardware, and more. It's fully
open-source and customizable, so you can extend it in whatever way you like.

[BUY NOW][15]

# What is Flipper Zero

### Your cyber buddy

Flipper Zero is a tiny piece of hardware with a curious personality of a cyber-dolphin. It can
interact with digital systems in real life and grow while you use it. Explore any kind of access
control system, RFID, radio protocols, and debug hardware using GPIO pins.

The idea of Flipper Zero is to combine all the hardware tools you'd need for exploration and
development on the go. Flipper was inspired by the pwnagotchi project, but unlike other DIY boards,
Flipper is designed with the convenience of everyday usage in mind — it has a robust case, handy
buttons, and shape, so there are no dirty PCBs or scratchy pins. Flipper turns your projects into a
game, reminding you that development should always be fun.

[Flipper Zero top view] 1.4" monochrome LCD display
128x64 px, ultra-low power
sunlight-readable 5-button directional pad Back button Status LED

Flipper Zero is completely autonomous and can be controlled with a 5-button directional pad without
additional devices, such as computers or smartphones. Main features are available from the Main
Menu.

For more control, you can connect to Flipper Zero via USB and Bluetooth. Instead of a TFT, IPS or
OLED, we decided to build in a cool old-school LCD.

# Sub-1 GHz Transceiver

### Sub-1 GHz Range

This is the operating range for a wide class of wireless devices and access control systems, such as
garage door remotes, boom barriers, IoT sensors and remote keyless systems. Users can expand their
Flipper Zero capabilities by installing additional apps to read data from various devices including
weather stations.

Flipper has an integrated multi-band antenna, and a CC1101 chip, making it a powerful transceiver
**with a range of up to 50 meters**.

Smart sockets and bulbs
IoT sensors and doorbells
Garage doors and barriers

### Customizable radio platform

CC1101 is a universal transceiver designed for very low-power wireless applications. It supports
various types of digital modulations such as 2-FSK, 4-FSK, GFSK and MSK, as well as OOK and flexible
ASK shaping. You can perform any digital communication in your applications such as connecting to
IoT devices and access control systems.

# 125 kHz RFID

### Low-frequency proximity cards

This type of card is widely used in old access control systems around the world. It's pretty dumb,
stores only an N-byte ID and has no authentication mechanism, allowing it to be read, cloned and
emulated by anyone. A 125 kHz antenna is located on the bottom of Flipper Zero — it can read
low-frequency proximity cards and save them to memory to emulate later.

You can also emulate cards by entering their IDs manually.
Moreover, Flipper Zero owners can share card IDs remotely with other Flipper Zero users.

# NFC

### High-frequency proximity cards

Flipper Zero has a built-in NFC module (13.56 MHz). Along with the 125 kHz RFID module, it turns
Flipper Zero into an ultimate RFID device operating in both low-frequency (LF) and high-frequency
(HF) ranges. The NFC module supports all the major standards.

Your highest-volume communication channel, treated like a real marketing surface. Brand-consistent

deployed fleet-wide in hours. Owned reach your team already runs every day.

The directory updates itself: every role, region, and reporting line flows in from the systems the

to make the introduction, the brand goes with them.

[Inside the corporate directory →][49]

The controls that keep IT confident, the integrations that connect the stack you already run, the

it takes to run your brand across the whole company, in one platform.

Chandler Hansen **Marketing Leader | Fairway Home Mortgage**

### Set your brand architecture.

Craft the experience that fits your brand. Colors, logos, and fonts become the templates behind

Connect to the stack you already run. Easily provision and scale across your organization, making
every update dynamic. Change once, update everywhere.

03

### Prove the Impact.

Make every interaction measurable. Transform conversations into data and tie every metric to real
dollars.

# MIFARE

Innovating for Tomorrow.

MIFARE is NXP’s well-known brand for a wide range of contactless IC products with a typical
read/write distance of 10 cm (4 inches) used in more than 40 different applications worldwide,
including contactless payments, transport ticketing and access control. MIFARE products comply with
the international standard ISO/IEC 14443 and can interact with Near Field Communication (NFC)
allowing a seamless communication between MIFARE products and NFC-enabled mobile devices.
* [Applications][9]
* [Products][10]
* [Partners][11]
* [Anti-counterfeit][12]
* [Design Resources][13]
* [News][14]

## MIFARE Applications

### Smart City
* [Access Management][15]
* [EV Charging Station][16]
* [Loyalty][17]
* Corporate ID
* Hospitality
* Student ID

### Automotive
* [Smart Car Access][18]

### Transportation
* [Transport Ticketing][19]

## Designed For The Form Factor of Choice
* Paper tickets
* Smart cards
* NFC enabled mobile devices
* NFC enabled wearables

## MIFARE Product Families

### [MIFARE DUOX®][20]

MIFARE DUOX is a high security product that combines asymmetric and symmetric cryptography in a
single chip. Ideal for access management, secure car access, EV-charging and more.

### [MIFARE DESFire®][21]

MIFARE DESFire is a highly secure solution with DES, 2K3DES, 3K3DES and AES hardware cryptography.
It can be integrated into mobile schemes and support multi-application smart card solutions.

### [MIFARE Plus®][22]

MIFARE Plus is equipped with enhanced performance and security features, offering quick,
cost-effective way to upgrade existing contactless infrastructures to AES security.

### [MIFARE Classic®][23]

MIFARE Classic is fully compliant with ISO/IEC 14443 Type-A; available with 1 kB and 4 kB memory and
7 bytes or 4-byte identifiers.

### [MIFARE 2GO][24]

MIFARE 2GO is a cloud service solution to manage digitized MIFARE product-based credentials on
mobiles and wearables.

### [MIFARE Ultralight®][25]

MIFARE Ultralight is delivering high security for limited-use tickets and key cards. Ideal for
replacing magstripe, barcode and QR-code infrastructures.

### [MIFARE SAM][26]

MIFARE SAM offers secure storage and communication for a variety of infrastructures.

## MIFARE Premium Partners
* [Weikeng Logo]
* [Paragonid Logo]
* [Linxens Logo]
* [HID Logo]
* [Adanide Logo]
* [Identiv Logo]
* [View all Partners][27]

## Genuine MIFARE Products for High Quality and Interoperability

NXP is taking actions against companies infringing our trademark rights or sell unauthorized product
copies to ensure our customers leverage the genuine MIFARE products in their businesses that come
with a high level of security, interoperability, stability and reliability.

### Anti-Counterfeit Activities

NXP is fighting against unauthorized MIFARE product copies through innovative and efficient
anti-counterfeiting activities.
* [Read the anti-counterfeit activities][28]

### Value of Genuine MIFARE Products

Genuine MIFARE products meet stringent quality procedures and industry standards for seamless
contactless experiences.
* [Read the brochure][29]

### Trademark and Branding Guidelines

Our Trademark and Branding Guidelines apply to all NXP customers, licensees, and third parties using
MIFARE trademarks or logos.
* [Read the guidelines][30]

### NFC TagInfo App

NXP’s NFC TagInfo App helps to identify the IC types on contactless cards and check origin of the IC
manufacturer.
* [Learn more][31]

Videos

Development Boards

Resources

allowing a seamless communication between MIFARE products and NFC-enabled mobile devices.

## Designed For The Form Factor of Choice
* Paper tickets
* Smart cards
* NFC enabled mobile devices
* NFC enabled wearables

## MIFARE Product Families

### [MIFARE DUOX®][20]

MIFARE DUOX is a high security product that combines asymmetric and symmetric cryptography in a
single chip. Ideal for access management, secure car access, EV-charging and more.

### [MIFARE DESFire®][21]

MIFARE DESFire is a highly secure solution with DES, 2K3DES, 3K3DES and AES hardware cryptography.
It can be integrated into mobile schemes and support multi-application smart card solutions.

### [MIFARE Plus®][22]

MIFARE Plus is equipped with enhanced performance and security features, offering quick,
cost-effective way to upgrade existing contactless infrastructures to AES security.

### [MIFARE Classic®][23]

MIFARE Classic is fully compliant with ISO/IEC 14443 Type-A; available with 1 kB and 4 kB memory and
7 bytes or 4-byte identifiers.

### [MIFARE 2GO][24]

MIFARE 2GO is a cloud service solution to manage digitized MIFARE product-based credentials on
mobiles and wearables.

### [MIFARE Ultralight®][25]

MIFARE Ultralight is delivering high security for limited-use tickets and key cards. Ideal for
replacing magstripe, barcode and QR-code infrastructures.

### [MIFARE SAM][26]

MIFARE SAM offers secure storage and communication for a variety of infrastructures.

In the kitchen - a touch activates a timer that is set to 15 minutes to cook a hard-boiled egg or an
app of recipes.

On the door frame - When leaving the house for a walk or a run, touch the sticker that will turn on
your music or radio player.

In a business, restaurant, shop, hotel - at the touch, the home site of the business immediately
opens with vital information.

5G and Internet of Things - enabled device will be required in IoT and 5G enabled networks for
easier implementation and efficiency.

of purchase, membership access, restricted area entrances, and custom apps.

guide)

opens with the phone with pictures of the dishes (actually opens a mini-website that you prepared in
advance)

alarm clock, lower the brightness of the screen. (Alternatively, just turn it off or switch to
flight mode).

whoever touches the tag with the phone will immediately receive step-by-step navigation instructions
for your business.

In the wallet (it is possible inside the wallet even) - electronic business card, anyone who touches
the wallet with his phone will receive your business card immediately to his phone. No need to read
phone number, email, etc.

Keyless Access - NFC and RFID tags can be used for access to doors and restricted areas with an auto
detect feature. It can be used to replace access keys, identification badges and for easier access
to cars and other vehicles.

large picture of the person they want to call (then maybe you should hide some stickers behind the

records by embedding tags to patient’s lists.

password, customers will touch the sticker on their desk and their phone will automatically receive
the network password and connect to the Internet.

another touch he will return to a normal profile. An additional sticker next to it will put the
phone in flight mode in case you really do not want to be disturbed.

type in an exhausting password) and the other contains your business card.

Internet, just touch the phone with a sticker on the back of the tablet and the phone will
immediately activate a hotspot for surfing the Internet. Of course another touch will turn off the
hot spot.

the process within a company, packaging and packaging products during shipment. Unique ID numbers
enable manufacturers to efficiently manage products when returned within the warranty period for
replacement, service and repair.

Sticker in the car - When touched, the phone will turn on Bluetooth (to connect to the headset),
turn on your favorite background music software and you can navigate. With another touch of the
sticker, the Bluetooth will turn off and with it the applications will also close and a diary screen
will open instead that shows you what your agenda is.

For quick and easy dialing - grandma and grandpa get involved with the smartphone? Stick a sticker
on them that as soon as they touch it with the phone, a call immediately goes to the number you set
in advance. You can put stickers in different colors for different people or just stick them on a
large picture of the person they want to call (then maybe you should hide some stickers behind the
picture for good coverage)

hours manually, whether for the purpose of calculating wages or even for the purpose of calculating
travel expenses. Stick two stickers on your desk, one of which will create an entry in the 'I got to
work' diary and the other will create an entry 'I moved home)' At the end of the month you can

[ What is a NFC tagify? ][45]

NFC Tagify is your premier destination for an extensive array of contactless digital business
solutions, offering a wide range of customised digital business
cards including metal NFC business cards, wood digital business cards, and PVC contactless business
cards. We specialize in NFC technology, providing versatile NFC cards, NFC stickers, NFC tags, and
NFC keyfobs.

Built on high-quality smart chips like NXP NTAG213, NTAG215, and NTAG216, our products cater to
diverse needs, be it sharing your social media links or your digital business profile. Our NFC
cards, NFC stickers and NFC tags are compatible with both Android and iPhone, ensuring universal
appeal and usability.Customise your experience with our user-friendly online platform. Create,
manage, and edit your digital business profile freely.

Unlike competitors who restrict you to their ecosystem, NFC Tagify offers you the freedom to
integrate third-party platforms such as Linktree and HiHello or even simple online v-cards or any
website link. Experience the convenience and flexibility of NFC technology with NFC Tagify
offerings.

[ What is a digital business card? ][46]

A digital business card is a modern, contactless alternative to traditional paper business cards.
Leveraging cutting-edge NFC technology, digital business cards can instantly share a wealth of
information such as your name, job title, contact details, social media profiles, and even
multimedia elements like videos or presentations.

All it takes is a simple tap of your card on an NFC-enabled smartphone—be it Android or iPhone—to
instantly transfer your details. The beauty of a digital business card is its dynamic nature. With
platforms like NFC Tagify, you have the flexibility to update your business information in real-time
without the need to reprint physical cards.

Whether you opt for metal NFC business cards, wood digital business cards, or PVC contactless
business cards, you can easily manage and edit your digital profile through a user-friendly online
platform.

Digital business cards are perfect for networking, marketing solutions, and making lasting
impressions. Their universal compatibility and contactless convenience make them a must-have in
today's fast-paced, digital world.

to be saved.

No apps are needed for either party.

Another way to share your digital business card details is by letting others scan the QR code on

[ What is a digital business card? ][46]

A digital business card is a modern, contactless alternative to traditional paper business cards.
Leveraging cutting-edge NFC technology, digital business cards can instantly share a wealth of
information such as your name, job title, contact details, social media profiles, and even
multimedia elements like videos or presentations.

All it takes is a simple tap of your card on an NFC-enabled smartphone—be it Android or iPhone—to
instantly transfer your details. The beauty of a digital business card is its dynamic nature. With
platforms like NFC Tagify, you have the flexibility to update your business information in real-time
without the need to reprint physical cards.

Whether you opt for metal NFC business cards, wood digital business cards, or PVC contactless
business cards, you can easily manage and edit your digital profile through a user-friendly online
platform.

impressions. Their universal compatibility and contactless convenience make them a must-have in
today's fast-paced, digital world.

Часто задаваемые вопросы
Какие смартфоны совместимы с нашей визиткой? Нужно ли приложение?

Практически все смартфоны с операционной системой Android старше 2014 года совместимы с функцией
сканирования умной визитки. Для устройств Android не требуется никаких специальных приложений. Как
правило, nfc-считыватель у Android находится по центру задней крышки телефона. Перед использованием
нужно включить функцию nfc. Сканирование QR-кода через камеру также поддерживается.

IOS – iPhone XS, XS Max, XR, 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro Max, 12, 12 Pro, 12 Pro Max совместимы с умной
визиткой и не требует никаких специальных приложений. У данных моделей nfc-считыватель находится
справа от задней камеры. QR-код можно считать через камеру смартфона.

Более ранние модели iPhone X, iPhone 8 (plus), iPhone 7 (plus), iPhone SE и iPhone 6S (plus) c
установленной 14 IOS могут считывать сигнал умной визитки через встроенный NFC-reader, который нужно
добавить в пункт управления. Также на данные модели iPhone (кроме SE и 6S), если не установлена 14
IOS, можно скачать специальное приложение. Ссылка на дополнительный софт отправляется по запросу. А
iPhone 6, 5, 4 и т.д поддерживают сканирование QR-кода, который также ведет на электронную визитку,
через камеру смартфона или специальные приложения для сканирования QR-кода.

Какую информацию можно указать в нашу визитку?

Контактная информация: ФИО, место работы, должность, любое количество номеров телефона, e-mail

Ссылки на внешние ресурсы: Ссылки на ваши сайты, новостные ресурсы или любую другую соц. сеть

Ссылки на профили в социальных сетях: Instagram, Facebook, VK, LinkedIn, YouTube, WhatsApp, Telegram

### Got Questions? We've Got Answers!

Can't find what you need? Contact our support team.

What is NFC technology?

NFC (Near Field Communication) is a wireless technology that allows devices to communicate when
they're close to each other. It's commonly used for contactless payments, data sharing, and quick
wireless interactions.

How does NFCWorlds use NFC technology?

At NFCWorlds, we harness the power of NFC for seamless communication and networking solutions.
Whether it's enabling smart connectivity or simplifying data transfers, our platform makes it easy
to integrate NFC into your tech stack.

What devices support NFC?

Most modern smartphones, tablets, and smartwatches come with built-in NFC support. You can use NFC
for payments, data sharing, and connecting with other NFC-enabled devices or systems.

Is NFC technology secure?

Yes, NFC technology is highly secure due to its short-range communication (usually within a few
centimeters), which makes unauthorized access difficult. NFCWorlds also implements advanced
encryption and security protocols to ensure your data remains safe.

### Proton for Business

Proton secures more than 100,000 businesses including some of the world’s largest public and private
organizations.

[Get Proton for Business][172][Explore
][173]

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

first.

### [125KHz RFID Tags][91]

Compared with high frequency and ultra-high frequency, 125kHz low-frequency tags are the least
interfered with by water and metal, RFID 125KHz tag is ideal for rough and tough industrial work,
metal mount, high temperature, and stickers to simple labels.

[ [13.56MHz RFID Tags][13.56MHz RFID Tags] ][92]

### [13.56MHz RFID Tags][93]

The 13.56 MHz tag was born to lower the RFID tags’ rate and address high-volume applications with
the high-frequency reader. At this frequency rate, a tag coil doesn’t need to be made of hard copper
wrappings.

### [UHF 915MHz RFID Tags][95]

The GEN2 UHF RFID Tags are verified by the FCC Standard Frequency range used in the Caribbean, South
America and North America. These RFID tags are 5 meters (16.4ft) which can be read quickly.

## How to choose the right RFID Tags

### 1.Make sure you have your own system

RFID tags cannot be used alone, so you need to make sure you have your own existing system or that
you are a system integrator so that you can purchase your own RFID tags.

### 2.Tell us the type of chip you are using

Chip is the core of RFID can store and exchange data, for the beginning of the system design will
choose a good chip model, different chip features and prices are different, so you need to determine
your own system to use the chip model.

If you do not know your own chip model, you can send us a sample of your hand to help you test the
chip model.

### 3.Select RFID Tags material and size

The price is different for different materials and sizes, so choose the right material and size for
you based on cost control.

### 4.Define your additional processes

We can customize the logo, print UID, Encoding data etc. for RFID Wristbands.

wrappings.

## How to choose the right RFID Tags

### 1.Make sure you have your own system

RFID tags cannot be used alone, so you need to make sure you have your own existing system or that
you are a system integrator so that you can purchase your own RFID tags.

### 2.Tell us the type of chip you are using

Chip is the core of RFID can store and exchange data, for the beginning of the system design will
choose a good chip model, different chip features and prices are different, so you need to determine
your own system to use the chip model.

If you do not know your own chip model, you can send us a sample of your hand to help you test the
chip model.

### 3.Select RFID Tags material and size

The price is different for different materials and sizes, so choose the right material and size for
you based on cost control.

### 4.Define your additional processes

We can customize the logo, print UID, Encoding data etc. for RFID Wristbands.

### Frequently Asked Questions
* ###### What is Zigpoll?
  
  Zigpoll is a contextual micro-survey tool. The idea is that you create small interactive surveys
  that show up where and when you want them on your website. The data you gather from surveys polls
  can then be used for lots of different things, like making your business better, increasing your
  conversion rate, and generating new leads.
* ###### How is Zigpoll different from Hotjar or other survey tools?
  
  Zigpoll is built specifically for eCommerce. We integrate directly with Shopify, trigger surveys
  based on purchase events, and connect your responses to actual customer data — not anonymous
  visitors. This means you can tie feedback directly to order value, customer segments, and lifetime
  value.
* ###### Will this slow down my site?
  
  No. Our script is under 20KB and loads asynchronously. It won't affect your Core Web Vitals or
  page speed scores.
* ###### What's included in the free plan?
  
  Zigpoll Lite is free forever and includes unlimited surveys, up to 100 responses per month, all
  question types, basic integrations, and email support. No credit card required to start. You can
  upgrade anytime to unlock unlimited responses, advanced integrations, and AI-powered insights.
* ###### Can I have multiple surveys on my website?
  
  Yes. You can have as many surveys as you want on your website. You can only show one survey per
  page though.
* ###### Can I put a specific survey on a specific page of my website?
  
  Yes. You can specify what pages you want a survey to show up on using our Page Rules. You can
  exclude certain pages, or match certain pages based on a variety of options. If you have trouble
  getting a survey on a certain page, email us and we'll be happy to help: [[email protected]][51].
* ###### Does this work for all websites?
  
  Yes. All you need to do is copy the embed code and place it within the head tag of your website
  and you will be all set. If you need help putting the code in, we are always here to help, just
  send us an email here: [[email protected]][52].
* ###### Can I customize my Zigpoll?
  
  Yes. You can change all the colors of your Zigpoll using the display tab. Each survey can have a
  different color scheme if you prefer.
* ###### Can I customize when my Zigpoll shows up?
  
  Yes. You can control where and when the survey shows up using the visibility tab. You can control
  each survey separately or all of them in bulk if you prefer.
* ###### Can I customize how many times the survey shows up?
  
  Yes. You can control how many times a user sees a survey using the visibility tab. You can also
  control if the survey hides immediately or if it continues to show up after it has been completed.
* ###### Can I get in touch with you for custom support?
  
  Absolutely! We pride ourselves on having world class support. Send an email to
  [[email protected]][53] or use our [contact form][54] and we will get in touch ASAP no matter what
  plan you are on or your request.
